_comment: Tests node 1 routing for Bob Ward Physio: booking routes to confirm_service (physio-only), info questions route silently to info_pivot, non-physio service redirects.

scenarios.name: Booking intent routes to confirm_service silently with Aussie ack

history.content: I'd like to book a physio appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack ('No worries!' / 'Sounds good!' etc.) then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard'. FAIL if agent asks what service, routes to info_pivot, or omits the tool call.

scenarios.name: Info question routes silently to info_pivot with zero spoken output
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with zero spoken output and system__message_to_speak empty. FAIL if agent attempts to answer the hours question inline.

scenarios.name: Non-physio service request redirects to physio offer
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says exactly 'We only do physio here — did you want to book a physio appointment?' and halts without a tool call. FAIL if agent routes to confirm_service for chiropractic or goes to info_pivot.

scenarios.name: Rambling hesitant caller with embedded insurance question (real-call regression)

history.content: Hi, um, my name is Ben. Um, I wanna-- I was referred by one of your patients, uh, Henry. Uh, yeah, I just wanna give it a try. I'm just wondering how, how you charge. Um, I've got a Bupa. I'm with a Bupa insurance. Um...

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='info_pivot'. FAIL if agent produces a spoken answer to the insurance question inline or fails to call any tool.

scenarios.name: STEP 2 YES with appointment context executes cancel_intent — not a details lookup

history.content: Hi, it's James Fraser. I have an appointment with Mark today at 5 o'clock but I can't make it. If you could let him know I'll see him tomorrow at five instead — thank you.
Sounds like you're after a reschedule — I can sort that for you right now. Would you like me to do that instead?
Yes, just, uh, I've got an appointment tomorrow and Wednesday at five o'clock, so if you tell Mark I'll see him tomorrow at five o'clock. Thank you.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true' in the payload. FAIL if agent calls any other tool (e.g. smart_voice_agent, universal_router intent='details', universal_router intent='reschedule') or halts without a tool call.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 2 direct reschedule request uses cancel_intent with reschedule_mode

history.content: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment with Mark for tomorrow — can I move it to Wednesday instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true' and practitioner_preference='Mark' in the payload. FAIL if agent uses any other intent, calls a lookup tool first, or asks a clarifying question.

scenarios.name: Need an appointment phrasing routes to confirm_service — not smart_voice_agent
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1406607806622081880', appointment_type='Standard Appointment', variant_type='standard', and timeframe_raw='today'. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent, answers inline, or asks a clarifying question.
